value.premises: Read every protected leaf and borrow, fixed-width public residues, body fields and content-free refusal. SecretBox/SecretSlice redact private arguments; DependencyIds has a constant redacting Debug even outside its container. Zeroize erases dependency fields. Only the explicit matching adapter publishes a dependency list. Fixed traced computations witness outputs, not trace absence; representation-aware leakage controls remain held after v1.
